title: Comparing Groups Worksheets for Kindergarten
intro: Use matching pairs to compare groups without relying on spacing.
html:
Teaching notes for parents and teachers

How to teach it

Line up the groups so each object can have a partner. Compare the leftovers, then spread one group out without changing its count.

Example to work through together

Use the model below as you explain the example. Have your student point to the quantities as you discuss them.

Group A: three counters.
Group B: six counters.

Make three pairs. All of Group A has partners, but three counters in Group B remain unmatched. Group B has more counters.

Ask your student

Did moving the objects change how many there are?

If your student needs help

If a wider row seems larger, match the objects again in pairs.
